lastCompletedStory.title: File-size ratchet (raising a ceiling requires tracker ref in diff)

nextStoryContext: File-size ratchet is live. Budget snapshots 126 tracked src/scripts/test files. Gate runs via 'bun scripts/check-file-sizes.ts'. DI pattern: getSizes/readBudget/getStagedDiff all injectable for unit tests. Lint needed two helper extractions (checkSizeCeilings, checkDiffTrackerRef) to get below biome's max cognitive complexity of 15. Bun Glob scanSync with {cwd} is correct; onlyFiles defaults to true. Next stories add more ratchet/dup gates.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Glob.scanSync({ cwd }) confirmed. onlyFiles defaults to true (correct, no need to pass explicitly). Pattern syntax {a,b}/{c,d} and *.{ts,tsx} are both valid. Implementation matches docs.
